ctx.x: Cascadú is a celebrated African percussionist and has performed frequently in New York City and in his native country of Trinidad. He has recorded with such notable artists as Jon Lucien, Jimmy Owens, and T.K. Blue. His solo recordings include “Caribbean Odyssey,” a collection of original pieces that are unmistakably Caribé.
Cascadú was interviewed in Clinton, New York on November 15, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
